cards.name: Artifact
cards.summary: A thing of power, and the hold it takes on whoever holds it.

cards.name: Beast
cards.summary: The animal inside the person: hunger, rage, the thing that bites.

cards.name: Broken One
cards.summary: Defeat and despair, and the long, slow work of being mended.

cards.name: Darklord
cards.summary: One ruler of terrible power, alone at the top of everything he owns.

cards.name: Donjon
cards.summary: The cell, of stone or of the mind, and whoever is shut inside it.

cards.name: Executioner
cards.summary: Judgment and its sentence; death delivered as a duty.

cards.name: Ghost
cards.summary: The past that will not rest; something dead that still wants.

cards.name: Horseman
cards.summary: Death itself, riding unhurried. It arrives for everyone, eventually.

cards.name: Innocent
cards.summary: The gentle one who has not yet learned what the world does to gentleness.

cards.name: Marionette
cards.summary: A thing worked by strings: the puppet, the spy, the servant someone made.

cards.name: Mists
cards.summary: The unknown. What lies past the edge of the cards' sight.

cards.name: Raven
cards.summary: Knowledge from a hidden source; help that arrives on an unexpected wing.

cards.name: Seer
cards.summary: Insight and inspiration; the one who sees through to what is true.

cards.name: Tempter
cards.summary: The offer too sweet to refuse and too costly to accept.

cards.name: Avenger
cards.summary: Swords, one. Justice that has started to enjoy itself: a debt paid back with interest.

cards.name: Paladin
cards.summary: Swords, two. A champion of the light who keeps faith even when faith stops keeping him.

cards.name: Soldier
cards.summary: Swords, three. The courage of the ranks: doing what you are told, and paying for it.

cards.name: Mercenary
cards.summary: Swords, four. A blade for hire, loyal for exactly as long as the coin lasts.

cards.name: Myrmidon
cards.summary: Swords, five. A warrior sworn to a cause so large it hides everything else from view.

cards.name: Berserker
cards.summary: Swords, six. Fury that has forgotten its reasons; strength that cannot stop.

cards.name: Hooded One
cards.summary: Swords, seven. The covered face: secrets, suspicion, the stranger nobody looks at twice.

cards.name: Dictator
cards.summary: Swords, eight. Rule by fear; a throne that rests on the people kneeling under it.

cards.name: Torturer
cards.summary: Swords, nine. Cruelty practised as a craft, suffering made to last.

cards.name: Warrior
cards.summary: The master of Swords. The perfect fighter: strength, and no questions asked of it.

cards.name: Transmuter
cards.summary: Stars, one. Change for its own sake; one thing made into another, for better or worse.

cards.name: Diviner
cards.summary: Stars, two. The seer: knowledge of what has not happened yet, and the weight of carrying it.

cards.name: Enchanter
cards.summary: Stars, three. Charm and compulsion; a will bent so gently it never feels the bending.

cards.name: Abjurer
cards.summary: Stars, four. The ward and the wall, which keep danger out and also keep things in.

cards.name: Elementalist
cards.summary: Stars, five. Fire, stone, water and storm, answering to a voice that may not deserve them.

cards.name: Evoker
cards.summary: Stars, six. Power called up to strike; the scholar made into a weapon.

cards.name: Illusionist
cards.summary: Stars, seven. Nothing is what it seems: the mask, the trick, the kind lie.

cards.name: Necromancer
cards.summary: Stars, eight. Mastery over death, which is never quite mastery, and always has a price.

cards.name: Conjurer
cards.summary: Stars, nine. What is called up from elsewhere, and what comes through behind it uninvited.

cards.name: Wizard
cards.summary: The master of Stars. Learning and long study, and the pride that tends to walk beside them.

cards.name: Swashbuckler
cards.summary: Coins, one. Dash and daring; the robber who bows to the purse he cuts.

cards.name: Philanthropist
cards.summary: Coins, two. Charity, true or performed; the giver, and what the gift buys.

cards.name: Trader
cards.summary: Coins, three. The fair exchange and the crooked one; every bargain hides a second price.

cards.name: Merchant
cards.summary: Coins, four. The shop and the scale; the patient pursuit of profit.

cards.name: Guild Member
cards.summary: Coins, five. Belonging bought with dues: the comfort of a fellowship, and its bars.

cards.name: Beggar
cards.summary: Coins, six. Want and need; the open hand, and the pride it costs to hold it out.

cards.name: Thief
cards.summary: Coins, seven. What is taken in the dark, and what was never truly anyone's.

cards.name: Tax Collector
cards.summary: Coins, eight. The share that power claims; corruption that keeps neat accounts.

cards.name: Miser
cards.summary: Coins, nine. Hoarding past all use; wealth that has come to own its owner.

cards.name: Rogue
cards.summary: The master of Coins. Cunning and ambition; the one who always knows the way out.

cards.name: Monk
cards.summary: Glyphs, one. Discipline and stillness; the self held quiet like water in a cup.

cards.name: Missionary
cards.summary: Glyphs, two. Faith carried into strange country, persuading or presuming.

cards.name: Healer
cards.summary: Glyphs, three. The hand that binds wounds, of the body and of the spirit.

cards.name: Shepherd
cards.summary: Glyphs, four. The keeper of a flock; protection that also leads.

cards.name: Druid
cards.summary: Glyphs, five. Root and season, the old order of the wild: merciless, and fair.

cards.name: Anarchist
cards.summary: Glyphs, six. Rules broken on principle; disorder held as a creed.

cards.name: Charlatan
cards.summary: Glyphs, seven. Holy robes worn for profit; the liar at the altar.

cards.name: Bishop
cards.summary: Glyphs, eight. Doctrine and rank; faith grown into an institution.

cards.name: Traitor
cards.summary: Glyphs, nine. Betrayal by the trusted; the knife that comes from beside you.

cards.name: Priest
cards.summary: The master of Glyphs. Devotion and spiritual leadership; the bridge between the mortal and the divine.
